name: square-dashed
description: A complete square boundary made of separated rounded strokes.
useCase: Identify a square selection boundary in drawing tools or shape selectors.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: Four rounded corner strokes follow the plain square’s frame while leaving each side open at text size.

24.reason: The rounded corners follow the plain square, with four middle strokes and clear gaps around all four sides.
